home.mission2en: Every recovered patient can become a light for others.
home.mission2zh: Every recovered patient can become a light for others.
home.intro: We share real experiences from patients and survivors, open-source non-drug, non-surgical daily care methods to help people reduce suffering.
home.motivationDesc: From a wish in 2014, to the app "Goodbye Hemorrhoids", to CommonBody today — do good without asking for reward.
home.storyDesc: From rural Anhui to six surgeries, then over a decade without another — the author's firsthand experience and lessons.
